description: The launch, spacecraft, satellite and space services employers whose roles SpaceJobs.Now fetches, most open roles first, each with where it hires, its open roles and the pay it posts. Narrow by name, segment, US state (employers hiring there) or kind of work (employers with open roles in it). The AI-training programs and job boards that are read appear too, labelled as such.

care.description: Segment of the space industry, one of: 'launch' (Launch & propulsion), 'spacecraft' (Spacecraft & stations), 'space-services' (Space data & services), 'ai-training' (AI training programs), 'job-boards' (Job boards we also read).

kind.description: Kind of work, one of: 'propulsion' (Propulsion), 'mechanical-structures' (Mechanical), 'avionics-electrical' (Avionics), 'rf-communications' (RF & Payloads), 'gnc-flight-software' (Flight Software), 'ground-software' (Software & IT), 'systems-test' (Systems & Test), 'manufacturing' (Technicians), 'launch-mission-ops' (Launch & Ops), 'quality-safety' (Quality), 'science-imaging' (Science & Data), 'supply-chain-facilities' (Supply Chain), 'business-programs' (Programs & Business), 'ai-training' (AI training).

state.description: A US state: its two-letter code (e.g. 'TX', 'NY') or its name ('Texas').

type.description: 'employer' (space companies and agencies; the default without a query), 'ai-program' (programs paying professionals for remote AI training work) or 'job-board' (sources of other employers' roles).

name: list_space_employers
title: Find space industry employers
